run_check_self_overlaps: run the script to check overlap between test and training data in multilingual NMT datasets
run_check_diff: run check_diff to find common sentence pairs between source and target parallel corpus files
run_get_directions: run get_directions to extract language direction pairs from training files in a data folder
run_diff_list: run diff_list to compute the set difference between two lists of items
run_check_overlaps_cli: run the CLI tool with --folder and --split args to detect data contamination across splits
